newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks hit new highs in busy trade.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks hit new highs in busy trade.

text.p: Madrid stocks closed at new highs on Monday, in positive vein helped by continued gains on Wall Street and strength in key stocks, dealers said.
The general index up 3.23 points, 0.82 percent, to 397.43 and the Ibex added 40.49 points, 0.89 percent, to 4,584.83.

"We've got the Dow Jones at highs, which we so far haven't matched. The market maybe needs to correct a little short-term but medium and long-term it's got great potential," said a trader at a European bank.
A second dealer at ABN-Amro said the bourse may take the opportunity to consolidate positions later this week when the U.S. is out for the Thanksgiving holiday.
Repsol continued to recoup after underperforming the Ibex this year, dealers said. IBCA's affirmation of debt ratings also provided a tonic, they added. It ended up 75 pesetas to 4,570.
Book-building for the sale of the state's 3.8 pct stake in Gas Natural also kicked off today, with the stock adding 690 pesetas to 25,890.
